subject: HelixAI — Commercial terms exception: liability cap & indemnity
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Nora Park <nora@helix.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelixAI — Commercial term exception: liability cap & indemnity

Team — quick summary and ask below. I’m looping Legal and Deal Desk because Helix signaled they will walk without an accommodation here. This is a strategic account (potential reference partner) and annual ARR is ~$1.2M (3-year committed volume).

What Helix is asking for (redlines received, attached):
- Increase vendor liability cap from our standard $1M to $10M (blanket cap)
- Add broad indemnity for third-party claims tied to customer data ingestion (no materiality threshold)
- Remove the majority of our warranty disclaimers; they want a 1-year product warranty for results
- Request for 30% first-year discount and logo rights

Why this is escalated:
- The cap increase and indemnity exposure materially change our risk profile for data-related claims; Legal has pushed back but the customer is threatening to pause the procurement process unless we can get exec-level flexibility.
- Sales view: close this quarter is important for ARR and for the AI marketplace go-live next month.

Proposed commercial compromise (from me):
- One-time increase of liability cap to $3M (not $10M), mutual cap on both parties for direct damages only
- Limit indemnity to IP infringement and willful misconduct; provide a narrow data-related indemnity with procedure and sublimits, not open-ended
- Warranty: keep limited warranty "will perform materially in accordance with documentation" + remedy of credits/bug fixes; no performance guarantees tied to results
- Accept 20% first-year discount (rather than 30%) if legal exceptions are approved

Ask: I need exec sign-off (CEO/Head of Revenue or Chief Legal) to approve the above exceptions so we can finalize. If approved, I will send the counter-redline and prepare for DocuSign.

Attachments: HelixAI-PSA-redline.pdf (customer redline), HelixAI-term-sheet-v3.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelixAI — Commercial term exception: liability cap & indemnity

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary and attaching the redline. I reviewed the draft and here are the legal implications and recommended redline language.

Key risk areas:
1) Liability cap jump to $10M: unacceptable without commensurate security and insurance mitigations. A unilateral $10M cap exposes us to outsized loss on data-related incidents.
2) Open-ended data indemnity: customer proposes indemnifying all third-party claims tied to data they ingest — that wording effectively makes us guarantee customer data quality and third-party behavior.
3) Warranty removal: customer seeks explicit performance warranty for results which is operationally risky.

Recommended counter (legal):
- Cap: agree to a one-time increase to $2.5M "for this agreement only", subject to incremental insurance purchase (we ask them to add us as additional insured on claims related to their use).
- Indemnity: keep IP infringement and gross negligence/willful misconduct as primary triggers. For data-related third-party claims, accept a narrowly scoped indemnity limited to direct damages where Redwood materially failed to follow documented ingestion procedures and only after a written cure period (30 days). Put a per-claim sublimit of $250k within the $2.5M cap specifically for data-related third-party claims.
- Warranty: amend to a limited warranty that Redwood will provide services in accordance with the SLA and documentation; exclude downstream results and any ML outcome guarantees. Remedy limited to re-performance and service credits.

Mitigations to propose to Sales/Rev: require SOC 2 Type II evidence and proof of insurance limits from Helix before increasing cap. Also require the deal sheet flag and Exec sign-off recorded in HubSpot.

If Sales wants to push higher than $2.5M, this needs explicit CEO approval and a risk acceptance memo signed by Legal + Finance.

Suggested language snippets I can put into the redline if you want me to prepare them.

-Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Team — after reviewing the background and Legal’s recommendations, I approve the proposed compromise with the following conditions:

1) Liability cap: approve increase to $2.75M for this PSA only (split the difference between Sales/Legal).
2) Data-related claims: accept the 30-day cure, per-claim sublimit of $250k and procedural requirements (notification & mitigation steps) as Aditya recommended.
3) Warranty: keep limited warranty language — no results guarantee; remedy limited to credits/re-performance.
4) Mandatory gating: Helix must provide SOC 2 Type II report and proof of insurance (minimum $5M umbrella) before any contract execution.
5) Commercial concession: approve 20% first-year discount if the above conditions are accepted and Helix signs within 7 calendar days.
